title: gold_eden.estimate_price_evidence
description: Eden Finance agent — deterministic evidence for 'why did this project's estimate price change' (Q1). One document per (tenantId, projectId, version) of silver.project_estimate. Reconciles SUM(silver.bom.total_cost) for the same version against project_estimate.material_cost, and resolves the vendor price (silver.material_cost via silver.vendor_material_map) that was in force at the estimate's created_at vs the immediately preceding price. Schema mirrors gold/src/eden/load_estimate_price_evidence.py shape_doc() exactly. Ruled out as causes: receipts.project_id / purchase_order.project_id (0/3 and 1/8 rows populated in the tenant checked) — not built on here.
x-etl-trigger: batch (run_pipeline.py); not yet wired into gold_eden_stream.py CDC trigger table — see reason field in infra/config/gold_config.yml loaders.load_estimate_price_evidence

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier. Part of the compound upsert key.

projectId.description: Project identifier cast to string. Part of the compound upsert key.

projectName.description: silver.project.description (pre-formatted '{customer}, {city}-{trade}-{orderNo}'), fallback customer display name, fallback order_no.

prevVersion.description: Immediately preceding version for the same project (window LAG), or null if this is the first version.

margin.description: Margin bucket, same row silver.project_estimate.margin reads from. NOTE (Q3): silver.role_permission has no permission distinguishing 'view an estimate' from 'view its margin' (all 149 distinct permission values checked) — a field-level RBAC gate on this property is application-layer logic, not yet enforced by ContractValidator or Mongo. See docs/canonical/user_access_management_model.md.

costDeltas.description: Per-bucket delta vs prevVersion (current - previous). Null when there is no previous version or either value is null.

changedBuckets.description: Names of costDeltas keys that are non-null and non-zero — which bucket(s) actually moved between prevVersion and version.

bomReconciliation.description: Deterministic proof mechanism: SUM(silver.bom.total_cost) for this (project, version), filtered invalid=FALSE, compared against project_estimate.material_cost.

reconciled.description: True when |delta| <= toleranceUsed — a deterministic, provable cause rather than a guess.

bomLines.description: BOM lines for this (project, version) — what changed (line added vs unit price rise), not just that something changed.

priceAtEstimate.description: silver.material_cost.cost effective at this estimate's created_at.

priceBefore.description: Immediately preceding material_cost.cost row (effective_enddate < createdAt), or null if none exists.

vendorPriceChanged.description: True only when both priceAtEstimate and priceBefore are known and differ — the concrete 'did the vendor's price change' signal.

materialPriceChanges.description: Subset of bomLines where vendorPriceChanged=true — the direct evidence for a vendor-price-driven estimate change.

_silverLsn.description: silver.project_estimate._s_lsn at write time. Upsert guard.

isDeleted.description: Always false — superseded project_estimate rows (invalid=TRUE) are excluded at the Silver query, not soft-deleted here.
